question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**form**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes dealing with Governmental red tape, which comes in various forms.
 
• "**Form**" refers to the specific manner or type of something, which fits the context.
 
• Other options ("**forum**", "**from**", "**farm**") do not fit the context of the sentence discussing types or varieties of red tape.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: He knew everyone on the island. Whenever his car stopped, half a dozen voices *would *__shout out his name. Policemen, agricultural labourers of low social status and priests waved and smiled __*____as___*__ he passed; everyone greeted him as a brother. They respected his honesty, and belligerence, and above all, they adored his typically Greek scorn and fearlessness when dealing with any __***form ***__of Governmental red tape. On arrival, two of our cases containing linen and other things had been ______ 4 ____ by the Customs on the curious ground that they were merchandise. So, when we moved out to the villa and the problem of bed linen arose, Mother told Spiro ______ 5 _____ our cases in the Customs and asked for his advice.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Forum (मंच): A place or medium where ideas and views can be exchanged, not suitable in this context.
 
• From (से): Indicates a point of origin or separation, not fitting the context of types of red tape.
 
• Farm (खेत): A piece of land used for agricultural purposes, irrelevant in this context.
